summary.text: 放 combines 攵, an action-related component, with 方 as a sound component. Its transmitted early gloss is “expel” or “drive away”; “release” and “let go” are also recorded meanings.

formation.text: The traditional analysis is phonosemantic: 攴, appearing in this position as 攵, contributes an action-related meaning, while 方 supplies the sound. A later proposal that 方 also means “distant” here, or that 攴 specifically means admonition, is uncertain.

components.text: 攵 is the positional form of 攴 in this traditional analysis and contributes an action-related meaning. A more specific meaning of admonition has been proposed, but remains uncertain.
方 is the sound component in the traditional analysis. A further proposal that it contributes the meaning “distant” is not established.

sound_limitation.text: The comparison uses system-dependent reconstructions. It supports a plausible sound relationship but does not establish the precise original phonetic identity or pronunciation.

sound.text: In the Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, 方 *paŋ (also *baŋ) compares with 放 *paŋ-s in its release reading. The shared *paŋ supports a plausible relationship; these reconstructions are not direct records of ancient speech.

history.text: The received Shuowen text glosses 放 as 逐, “expel” or “drive away,” and analyzes it as 攴 plus phonetic 方. A classical-text tradition records this banishing sense in a passage dated approximately to the fourth century BCE; that estimate does not date a surviving manuscript.

A Taiwan dictionary reports a Warring States Zhongshan Wang Hu form as a variant later regularized as 放. Its image was not visually examined, so the available account does not support describing its shape or specific changes to the graph.

uncertainties.text: The available accounts do not establish a securely dated earliest graphic occurrence, a complete sequence of ancient forms, or graphic corruption.
The reconstructed comparison makes 方 a plausible phonetic component, but it does not identify a depicted object or establish a whole-character borrowing account.

A scholarly proposal derives “reach” from “banish” or “send away,” drawing on Mencius passages and Han commentary. The development remains disputed, and a complete chronology linking older and modern senses is unresolved.

senses.period: Dating unresolved; reported in the transmitted Shuowen account and a classical-text tradition dated approximately to the fourth century BCE
senses.text: The transmitted Shuowen account gives the gloss 逐, “expel” or “drive away.” The approximate date assigned to a classical example does not date surviving manuscripts.

senses.period: Historical and current; precise chronology unresolved
senses.text: “Release,” “let go,” and “set free” are recorded meanings. Their chronology and a complete path from “expel” are not established.

senses.period: Historical use reported in Mencius; underlying word’s first attestation unresolved
senses.text: Several Mencius uses have been interpreted as “reach,” with a proposed development from “banish” or “send away.” This connection remains disputed.
A distinct reading meaning “imitate” is recorded. Its chronology and historical relationship to the release reading are unresolved.

senses.gloss: place or set down; expand; distribute; emit or shoot; play a recording
senses.period: Later and current uses; sequence unresolved
senses.text: These uses are recorded, but their chronology and direct semantic links are not established.

limitations.text: The chronology and semantic connections among “expel,” “release,” “reach,” “imitate,” and other recorded uses remain unresolved. In particular, the proposed development to “reach” is disputed.

Reconstructed pronunciations support a plausible component-level sound comparison but are not direct recordings of ancient speech. No supported whole-character phonetic loan explains the recorded meanings.

overview.text: 放 combines 攵, an action-related element, with 方 as a sound component. Its transmitted early gloss is “expel”; common meanings include “release” and “let go.”

components.text: 攵 contributes an action-related meaning in the traditional analysis; its more specific proposed meaning of admonition is uncertain.
方 supplies a plausible sound cue. The additional idea that it means “distant” here is not established.

relationships.text: The traditional analysis identifies 方 as phonetic, and reconstructed readings support a plausible sound relationship.
The traditional analysis treats 攴, represented here by 攵, as the action-related semantic component.
